# AGENTS.md — 17-podcast

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Long Wave**, podcast, style "Braun-era radio receiver".
- Stack: SvelteKit 3, Svelte 5, Web Audio. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/lib/content.js` — episodes with frequencies, hosts, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/routes/+page.svelte` — page, tuner logic, Web Audio
- `src/app.css` — tokens at the top
- `vite.config.js` — SvelteKit 3 config lives in the Vite plugin

## How to run
- `npm install          # Node 22.17+`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./build`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Episodes are stations on a frequency scale: drag the tuning knob (or use arrow keys) — static between stations, a tone when tuned.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- One colour (orange) only for 'on air' things: lamp, needle, tuned station.
- Rounded hardware shapes; no gradients except the knob's knurling.
- Every control works with the keyboard; the knob is role=slider.
- Sound is synthesised — never autoplay; Power starts audio.
- Episodes are data with a frequency (88–108).

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
